subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Is the extracted terminal proof enough for this retry/session change, or should maintainers require full-runner or gateway proof before merge?
rationale: The patch changes session-state and message-delivery retry behavior, and the contributor proof does not show a real gateway or full-runner recovery path.

options.title: Require full-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs or a gateway/full-runner artifact showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate tool or delivery side effects before merge.

options.title: Accept extracted proof
options.body: Proceed with maintainer-owned risk based on predicate output, fault-injected tests, and the source-level behavior matrix.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs or a gateway/full-runner artifact showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate tool or delivery side effects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the same embedded runner retry and harness-contract surface.
